ValidationRule.description: As a marketer, when I am trying to update the campaign status to Confirmed but the parent campaign is not Confirmed yet, I should be blocked and notified to update the parent campaign status to Confirmed, so the data is kept consistent.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: ISCHANGED(Status) && ParentId != null && NOT( ISPICKVAL(Parent.Status, 'Confirmed') ) && NOT( ISPICKVAL(Parent.Status, 'In Progress')) && ISPICKVAL(Status, 'Confirmed')
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You cannot change the child status to Confirmed if parent status not Confirmed yet
